checks.name: Traditional Chinese is the default; one button is selected
English translates all body, UI, navigation, and diagram text
Code, official links, and all section IDs remain identical
Button focus, pressed state, status, and document language agree
Returning to Chinese restores the complete original article
Language selection is restored on a subsequent page load
Explicit URL language overrides saved preference and preserves the chapter
Invalid saved and URL values fall back to Chinese
Switching works when storage and history updates are blocked
The downloaded file switches languages without network resources
Reading-position logic follows the current paragraph rather than a distant heading
A chapter just below the toolbar is preserved instead of bookmarking an offscreen block
Switching above the article does not scroll the title or mobile contents
Back and Forward restore the language associated with the history entry
Printing uses one article and hides the controls

scope: DOM behavior, state, source integrity, offline resources, and simulated reading-position geometry. This is not a browser layout or end-to-end test.
